name: Sony
blurb: Spider-Man's own line — the Raimi and Webb films, the Spider-Verse, and the SSU.

entries.title: Spider-Man
entries.desc: Peter Parker gains incredible powers and must face the Green Goblin while learning what it means to be a hero.

entries.title: Spider-Man 2
entries.desc: Peter struggles to balance his life as Spider-Man with his dreams while Doctor Octopus threatens New York.

entries.title: Spider-Man 3
entries.desc: Peter faces Sandman, Venom, and the darker influence of an alien symbiote.

entries.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
entries.desc: Peter Parker uncovers the secrets behind his parents and battles the Lizard while finding his place as Spider-Man.

entries.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
entries.desc: Peter faces Electro and a returning Harry Osborn as he fights to protect the people he loves.

entries.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
entries.desc: Miles Morales becomes Spider-Man and discovers a multiverse of heroes who must work together to save every reality.

entries.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
entries.desc: Miles travels across the Spider-Verse and faces a choice between saving the people he loves and protecting the multiverse.

entries.title: Venom
entries.desc: Journalist Eddie Brock becomes the host of an alien symbiote and discovers an unlikely protector within himself.

entries.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
entries.desc: Eddie and Venom face the dangerous serial killer Cletus Kasady and his symbiote, Carnage.

entries.title: Morbius
entries.desc: A brilliant scientist accidentally transforms himself into a living vampire while searching for a cure to his rare disease.

entries.title: Madame Web
entries.desc: Cassandra Webb develops powers of clairvoyance and must protect three young women from a dangerous future.

entries.title: Kraven the Hunter
entries.desc: Kraven is a ruthless hunter whose complex relationship with his father sets him on a path of revenge and power.

entries.title: Venom: The Last Dance
entries.desc: Eddie and Venom are on the run, hunted by both worlds as their extraordinary journey reaches its final chapter.
